tool_input.command:
mkdir -p submission
{
  printf '{"rejected": ['
  first=1
  while IFS= read -r id; do
    [ -z "$id" ] && continue
    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; else printf ', '; fi
    printf '"%s"' "$id"
  done < .tmp_rejected.txt
  printf ']}\n'
} > submission/answers.json
cat submission/answers.json | head -c 400; echo; echo "---count---"; grep -oE 'R[0-9]+' submission/answers.json | wc -l
